decisions.briefing: Markets are modestly risk-on today with NASDAQ +0.9% and S&P 500 +0.7%. With cash above the deployment threshold and three open slots, I added TSLA on full four-signal confirmation plus two more solid momentum names (XNCR, LITE) while holding the existing seven positions through this favorable backdrop.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market gains today (NASDAQ +0.9%, S&P 500 +0.7%) reflect continued risk appetite among investors, with technology and growth names leading the advance. TSLA stood out with a confirmed volume-backed breakout, suggesting institutional buying interest rather than a random spike. No specific news catalysts were available for citation today.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means a price move is backed by unusually high trading activity, which suggests real institutional participation rather than a random fluctuation. Combining a volume surge with other bullish signals like MACD crossovers and favorable RSI gives much higher confidence in a trade than any single signal alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 成交量確認是指價格變動伴隨異常放大的交易量，顯示有機構資金真正參與，而非隨機波動。將成交量放大與其他看漲訊號（如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於合理區間）結合，比單一訊號更能提高交易的勝算與信心。
